title: Loot ke Aayi Hai Watan Dil Ko Sambhale Zainab
body:
Loot ke aayi hai watan dil ko sambhale Zainab
Sah gayi Shaam mein bhi zulm niraley Zainab
1. Ho chukey aoun o mohd bhi nisar e shabbir
Kar chuki unko bhi khaliq ke hawaley Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Ibne shabbar ka badan hogaya ran mein pamaal
Se gayi dil pe magar zulm ke bhaley Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Khak mein milgayi akber ki jawani nana
Kis tarha apne kaleje ko shambhaley Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Bhai ne sinaye akber se seena khachi
Hai gham ko yeh kis tarha seeney se nikaley Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Qabrey zehra pe tha Zainab e muztar ka bayan
Kar chuki haq pe goad ki paaley Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Tehniyat aayi yeh zehra ki sada marqad se
Tujh ko koun meri jaan sambhaley Zainab
Azz:- tehniyat kirmani.
